title: Humpback Whales Recovered To 25,000 After Hunting Ended
hook: Protection rebuilt a humpback population to 25,000 whales.
closing: Recovery proves protection works when killing stops long enough.
question: Should commercial whaling stay banned?

segments.say: South Atlantic humpbacks reached 25,000 whales. Protection turned near-erasure into recovery.
Ten humpback populations are fully recovered. Saving a species is difficult, not hopeless.
Commercial whaling killed 2.9 million large whales. Ending that pressure made recovery possible.
